_comment: Reference contract for automated remediation pull requests.
Copy to .devin/contract.json in a remediation branch and fill in the
advisories, version floors and test paths that the change is claiming.
`checks` may only name entries from the allowlist in
commands. Requesting an unknown check fails the gate immediately.
npm-audit-advisories  target advisories absent from `npm audit --json`
osv-advisories        target advisories absent from pinned Python reqs
version-floor         named packages sit at or above a minimum version
jest-scoped           `npm run test` passes for the listed paths
Only typecheck and jest-scoped install node_modules; the others read the
lockfile and manifests, so a security-lane gate finishes in about a minute.
